meta.note: Every step is cited to app/data/sources.json by number. Steps were written fresh on 21 Nov 2026 from the v2 guide paragraphs and the 28 sources; the two genuine content corrections (Gunslinger, Let's Go Bowling) follow PowerPyx, OutputLag and GTABase. Per-trophy sources is the exact union of that trophy's steps' and disputes' src arrays.

disputes.q: How long does the Platinum take — 200 hours or 300?
disputes.b: Up to 300 hours or more (Push Square, marked WIP).
disputes.call: Budget ~200 hours for the checklist route; the 300-hour figure counts doing everything in the game, not just the checklist.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the Platinum pops on its own the moment the last one lands.
No online trophies, no DLC and no extra task — if it has not popped, one trophy in the tracker is still open.
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end.
It pops during the story with no extra effort — the first trophy most players earn.

disputes.q: Which mission number is Down to Earth in Chapter 1?
disputes.b: 13th (Beebom) / 16th (GTABay, counting the Prologue and optional missions).
disputes.call: Same mission either way — the lists count the Prologue and optional missions differently.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter close.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — the one possibly-missable interaction.
Keep a manual save at the Chapter 1 boundary; there is no mission replay.

disputes.q: T**s or T*ts — how is the trophy name spelled?
disputes.call: PSN publishes it as T**s — that is the spelling used here.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2 in full.
The name is censored in trophy lists; PSN publishes it with two asterisks.
Finish Chapter 3.
Start scanning unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals with binoculars as you travel — both feed the 100% checklist.
Finish Chapter 4.
The big bank-vault robberies open around here through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — leave the eight large vaults until then.

disputes.q: How many story missions are there — 91, 93, 95 or 122?
disputes.b: 93 (Push Square) / 95 (VGC walkthrough hub) / 122 including optional missions (GTABay).
disputes.call: The counts differ by what they include — optional missions and the Prologue. The story itself is the same.

steps.text: Finish the final story mission.
After the credits, free roam opens and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats.
Most of the Platinum grind happens after this point — switch to the roadmap stages.
Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
No side objective is needed — it unlocks by playing the mission through.
Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Treat heist missions as practice for the Stage 4 robbery trophies — the same escape-and-lose-the-heat loop applies.
Complete the story mission Child's Play.
Unmissable as long as you play the story to the end.
Complete the story mission Headliners.
Another story-automatic trophy — it cannot be missed on a playthrough that reaches the finale.
Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport.
Learn the runway and terminal layout here — the airport is also the scene of Catch Me If You Can in Stage 4.
Expect heavy airport security on the way out; the mission itself has no extra objective.
Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
The last of the named-mission story trophies; after it, only the finale stands between you and post-story cleanup.
Finish the story — the checklist only appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits, but earlier progress already counts.
Complete 100 optional tasks (black icons with pink letters, plus purple map icons).
Clear all robberies in full: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, 8 vaults.
Fence the four money goals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills, $200,000 vehicles.

Finish the collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 flamingos, 5 of 7 Kenton sets, 2 playlists, 70 of 79 styles.

Finish the activities: 30 of 40 unique races won, 10 of 13 race challenge golds, 42 shooting-range golds, 4 video games played, 5 of 7 pool opponents, 2 of 3 mini golf, 90 of 100 basketball hoops, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret's target decks.
Finish discovery: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 50 of 66 standard-issue weapons found, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything stays available in free roam after the story.
Work the robbery and fencing numbers first — they also fund the garage and money trophies.
The story alone is worth 50% of the checklist; optional tasks 6%, gang operations 3%, the rest 1-2% each.
Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
The checklist wants 300, so keep stunting past this trophy.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Do this early — it is a fast Bronze and teaches you which activities feed the checklist.
A race counts whether it is a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race.
Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.
This is also required in full for 100%, so budget real practice time.
Learn one range's timing first, then repeat the pattern — accuracy and speed both matter, and replays are free.
Guides disagree on the range count — 12 ranges (GameTrek) vs two ranges holding all 42 golds (OutputLag) — but the target is the same: gold in all 42 challenges.
Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
The checklist separately wants all 42 drone time trials — fly every course twice: once to win, once to beat the trial time.
Learn the gates before pushing speed.
Win 20 different races across Leonida.
The checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so this trophy lands on the way.
Vary the race types instead of repeating one favourite, and keep a different vehicle ready for each discipline.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Take the challenge when it appears; watch the line tension instead of mashing.
Reel steadily when the fish runs.
Complete any one arcade game — any of the four in-game games counts.
Pick the shortest cabinet you find and finish a full run.
The checklist also wants you to play all four video games, so note which cabinets you have tried.
Finish Andy's stranger strand through to his final mission, Puff Puff Pass.
Stranger strands unlock as you explore — check the map for stranger icons after each chapter.
Clear strands before moving on rather than leaving them all for the endgame.
Finish Kenton's strand to his final mission.
Kenton also ties into treasure sets — five of his seven sets count toward 100%.
Pick up his collectibles while his missions take you around the map.
Finish Billy's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Billy's missions are bike-heavy — keep a fast bike in your garage.
Sweep the map icons between chapters rather than leaving strands for the endgame.

disputes.q: Do the five named-character finals count toward the 8 strands?
disputes.a: Yes — all eight stranger strands count, including the named finals (KeenGamer, PowerPyx).
disputes.b: No — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do NOT count, only some questlines do (OutputLag).
disputes.call: Check the in-game strand counter after each strand you finish — only strands that move the counter count.

steps.text: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Check the trophy's in-game strand counter after each strand you finish — only strands that move the counter count.
OutputLag reports Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do NOT count, because they have their own trophies.
Do Yago's timed race the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it carries an hourglass icon and its strand counts.
Sweep the map icons between chapters rather than leaving all strands for the endgame.
Finish Randy's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Randy's work leans on supply runs — stock up on ammo and armour before his later missions.
His later missions escalate quickly, so go in prepared.
Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Clear Tyrone's strand before the finale if you can — stranger missions are easier to track while the story is still feeding you map icons.
Note the dispute on Strangers & Freaks: Tyrone's strand is one of the three OutputLag says do not count toward the 8.

disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for the trophy?
disputes.a: Yes — all 18 are required and the balcony counts (OutputLag, Beebom, GameTrek).
disputes.b: Unconfirmed — the balcony spot is not marked like the rest and the final Ascent meditation may count +2 (PowerPyx, Bloxodes, TheGamersHub).
disputes.call: Do the balcony in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save — it costs nothing and removes the risk.

disputes.q: Does the trophy need 15 or 18 meditations?
disputes.a: 15 of 18 for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx 100% guide, Push Square).
disputes.call: 15 counts toward 100%; the trophy needs all 18.

steps.text: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — 10 spots, 18 meditations.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first: after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Each outdoor spot counts twice — once for Jason, once for Lucia — after both are playable from Chapter 2 (Coffee Break).
The other 8 outdoor spots: Smooth Sand, Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall, Seaside.
The final Ascent Mountain meditation appears on the map only after all other spots are done.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or filter the map by Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 — but this trophy needs all 18.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops; the balcony cannot be redone after Chapter 1.
Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
Bret's hunting work feeds the 100% checklist — all 15 of his Target Deck objectives are required there.
Bret texts Jason some time after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; Lucia never gets the strand.
Complete three full collectible card sets.
The checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so three is only the start.
Collect cards whenever you pass a spawn, and trade duplicates rather than hunting single cards across the map.
Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count.
The checklist needs the same 100 scans, so this trophy and the checklist finish together if you scan as you go.
Open the app on every new vehicle and landmark from the very first hour.
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.
The checklist wants 70, so pick the 50 easiest first and leave the hardest ten entirely alone.
Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges and many complete on their own while you play.
Lose a four-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat.
Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns this.
The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone — getting out of the flashing search area is not enough.
Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level.
Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
Discover 100 vehicles — a WAiNK scan counts as a discovery.
The checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so keep going past 100.
Scan traffic as you drive — a WAiNK scan is enough, you do not need to drive the vehicle.
Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming).
Police, soldiers and civilians do NOT count — pick a gang shootout at an illegal operation, where the targets are gang members.
Buff Focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline to extend it mid-fight.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs — and level Focus to 3-4 first for more time.
Wear body armour so you can walk out of cover and get close to the enemies.
At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere do not count.
Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off.
The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops.
Save first — the police come fast the moment you cross the tarmac.
Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat.
Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys.
Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Yasmani's Chapter 3 job Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies — use it on a store's locked back door; kicking the door in sets off the alarm.
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload and try again.
Rob five bank vaults and escape.
Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4 — tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open.
The checklist needs all eight vaults, so five is a milestone, not the end.
Rob an armored truck and escape.
Armored trucks run set routes around the city — ram one to a stop or block it, crack it open and grab the cash.
Break line of sight before the police box you in; a bike is the best getaway here.
Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map.
Drive, fly and sail the edges — the map fills in as you travel.
Combine this with WAiNK scans and stunt runs instead of making dedicated map trips.
Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.
The checklist wants all 39 gang operations, so this is a down-payment on that.
Keep a checklist of which gangs you have hit and do not double up on one gang while another is untouched.
UNCONFIRMED as of 21 Nov 2026: the description points to enjoying a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach — try ordering a drink at a beachfront bar there and lingering at the view.
Treat any single-source method as a rumour until a second source confirms it; do not burn a save on this one.
UNCONFIRMED as of 21 Nov 2026: the hint is to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the old drive-through-the-window exit.
Try it with a sturdy car at a showroom, but the exact trigger is still being confirmed across sources — verify before repeating.
Hit Kingpin Bowling is an optional mission in Chapter 2 (after Coffee Break) at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
You do NOT need all 3 valuables in one visit: the operation respawns after a long while, so it is not missable — previously collected valuables still count when you return.

The three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the pool table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the small north-east office — blow it open with Sticky Bombs from Ammu-Nation.
The trophy pops after escaping the police — exit the alley, find a vehicle and drive away; it is a bit delayed.
If you missed a valuable, wait for the alley icon to respawn (long cooldown, some time in Chapter 3) and grab what you missed.
Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you.
Gym work, melee and heavy lifting raise Strength over time; switch characters when one caps out.
Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile.
Robberies, crimes, escapes and story choices all feed it — it fills up without a separate grind.
Check the profile counter in-game to see how close you are.
UNCONFIRMED as of 21 Nov 2026: the only published hint is 'Second time's the charm', which suggests failing something once and succeeding on the retry.
No source has confirmed what that something is — do not chase guesses; check back after more players report it.
UNCONFIRMED as of 21 Nov 2026: the only published hint is 'What the hell just happened?', which reads like a rare random event or easter egg.
No source has confirmed a trigger — leave this one for last.
Watch for new reports rather than grinding blind.
METHOD BEING CONFIRMED as of 21 Nov 2026: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — a melee strike from a moving vehicle that knocks a target down like a bowling pin.
Try it at the bowling alley area, but the precise method is still being confirmed across sources.
KeenGamer still marks this method unconfirmed — treat any how-to as provisional.
Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.
Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts — the $250,000 total is cumulative.
The checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
Spend a total of $100,000 across shops — weapons, clothes, food and gear all count, and the total is cumulative.
Do not force it early: by the time you have bought the garages, weapons and ammo for a full 100% run, this will already be close.
Track the total as you play — every shop purchase counts toward it.
Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties.
Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver — together they cost about $160,000.
Garages the story gives you do not count; buy each garage as soon as you can afford it.
Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app — take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register.
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray; each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
